title: Formalize Alon's Combinatorial Nullstellensatz in Lean

problemStatement.formal: \operatorname{coeff}_{\prod_i X_i^{t_i}}(f)\ne 0,\quad \deg f\le \sum_i t_i,\quad |S_i|>t_i\ \Longrightarrow\ \exists s\in\prod_i S_i,\ f(s)\ne 0.
problemStatement.plain: Formalize Alon's Combinatorial Nullstellensatz: a polynomial with a nonzero maximal-degree coefficient cannot vanish on every sufficiently large grid. The Lean development proves the single-variable non-vanishing base case and states the grid/nonvanishing theorem with two explicit axioms.
whyMatters: Cornerstone of the polynomial method in combinatorics
Applications to Cauchy-Davenport, Chevalley-Warning, graph coloring

proven: `exists_eval_ne_zero` proves the single-variable non-vanishing result from polynomial root-count bounds.
`combinatorial_nullstellensatz'` and `nonvanishing_uniform_grid` derive useful corollaries from the main axiomatized theorem.
open: `grid_nonvanishing` and `combinatorial_nullstellensatz` are axioms in the current OQ-02 file.
A fully internal proof still needs grid non-vanishing by induction and multivariate polynomial reduction infrastructure.
knownResults.goal: Make the axiom boundary explicit while preserving the proved single-variable base case and corollary metadata.

currentState.focus: Initial formalization with clean statement and single-variable base case.
blockers: Multivariate polynomial division not in Mathlib
currentState.nextAction: Prove grid_nonvanishing by induction, then tackle polynomial reduction.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Formalized Alon's Combinatorial Nullstellensatz. Proved single-variable non-vanishing from Mathlib root bounds. Axiomatized grid non-vanishing and full theorem. 2 axioms, 5 theorems, 0 sorries.
builtItems: Created FactorRemainderNullstellensatzOQ02.lean with clean formal statement
Proved exists_eval_ne_zero: single-variable non-vanishing from card_roots_le_degree
Axiomatized combinatorial_nullstellensatz with precise type signature
Proved two corollaries: alternative |Sᵢ| ≥ tᵢ + 1 version and uniform grid specialization
insights: The single-variable base case is clean: by_contra + push_neg gives all roots, then card_roots_le_degree contradicts |S| > deg
Monomial multi-indices use Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm to convert σ → ℕ to σ →₀ ℕ
The main formalization barrier is MvPolynomial division modulo grid polynomials ∏(xᵢ - s)
Grid non-vanishing is provable by induction on σ using the single-variable case — could be next step
The theorem works over any field, not just algebraically closed — key distinction from Hilbert's Nullstellensatz
mathlibGaps: No multivariate polynomial division (reducing MvPolynomial one variable at a time) in Mathlib
MvPolynomial.degreeOf bounds under evaluation/substitution could be strengthened
nextSteps: Prove grid_nonvanishing by induction on Fintype σ cardinality
Formalize Cauchy-Davenport theorem as a consequence
Build MvPolynomial division infrastructure for removing main axiom
